methodology.geodesic: Quaternion geodesic after aligning each estimate's startup heading to truth at sample 0. This removes the unobservable 6D initial yaw gauge.
methodology.heading: B2 relative heading drift aligned at sample 0; no absolute yaw metric because no absolute heading aid is supplied.
methodology.orientation_truth: Analytic quaternions for synthetic fixtures; no recorded or BROAD trial data.
methodology.parameters: Each adapter uses its pinned documented defaults/versioned fixed configuration; no tuning on sealed trials.
methodology.same_input: Each adapter receives the same B1 trial JSON; the input SHA-256 and sample count are checked before scoring.
methodology.statistics: Per-trial summaries only. Within-trial samples are correlated and are not treated as independent replicates; no population confidence interval is reported.
methodology.tilt: Gravity-axis angular error from B2; invariant to global yaw gauge.
methodology.timing: Runtime comparisons are omitted because adapters run in separate dependency environments.

not_run.reason: No firmware-independent ESKF adapter is registered in the B1 benchmark API, and no C++ compiler is installed for the native PR3 runner.
